dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is real inbox-placement testing, and the described MCP tools create tests, return seed mailboxes, read placement/authentication results, optionally use screenshots, and pause risky outbound sends.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to outbound preflight workflows, include quota discipline, prefer small provider sets, require explicit user override for failed checks, and constrain deletion to user request or retention policy.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation runs the third-party ldm-inbox-check-mcp package via npx and requires an INBOX_CHECK_API_KEY; this is disclosed and expected for the integration, but users should trust the package and provider before enabling it.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The API key, paid remote calls, seed-message submission, authentication metadata, and screenshots are proportionate to inbox testing, though users should treat campaign drafts and headers as data sent to an external service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts show no local persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, broad file indexing, or hidden credential handling; the irreversible delete capability is disclosed and limited.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The third-party data flow is inherent to real inbox testing: the skill says it sends the exact final draft to seed addresses and reads placement, authentication, headers/screenshots. The README could add a clearer privacy warning, but the behavior is disclosed in the skill instructions and not purpose-mismatched.
[SQP-3] expected: The production base URL and masked icp_live_ key format are examples for a paid production service, not evidence of a live secret or hidden endpoint. This is documentation hygiene rather than a material security concern.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is pending only and does not conflict with the clean static scan or coherent artifact review.
llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the LDM Inbox Check service and npm package. Store INBOX_CHECK_API_KEY securely, expect paid quota usage, and avoid submitting regulated or confidential campaign content unless your vendor/privacy requirements allow sending drafts, headers, authentication results, and screenshots to this external provider.
llm.summary: This skill clearly sets up a paid third-party inbox-placement check for outbound email and its sensitive behaviors are disclosed and aligned with that purpose.
